title: MegaAsk
tagline: Anonymous questions to anyone onchain. Encrypted, onchain, fun.
description:
Find out what people want to know about you. Ask questions and get answers on any topic onchain! 

The social app allows you to ask anyone on the onchain questions. Simply, user A publishes a question to any ENS or Ethereum address, and this address receives NFT with an encrypted question.
how_its_made:
The objective of this project is to create a sample demo for a Questions and Answers (Q&A) platform that leverages on-chain identity through Ethereum Name Service (ENS) or blockchain addresses. The demo is implemented using TypeScript, providing a robust and type-safe development environment.

Frontend: https://github.com/everdimension/ask-fm-onchain-hackathon-jul-2024
Backend: https://github.com/feezboom/ethglobal-2o24
